#### 1. Laron syndrome  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.745)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:4263)

Loss-of-function mutations in the Growth Hormone Receptor (GHR) gene disrupt the downstream IGF-1 signaling pathway, leading to a spectrum of phenotypes including short stature (characteristic of Laron syndrome) and impaired glucose metabolism and obesity (associated with other GHR-related conditions).

**How to falsify it:** The identification of pathogenic variants in GHR that lead to loss-of-function in one disease and gain-of-function in the other, or the absence of any shared variants in GHR in affected individuals of both diseases. _(variant: rs777600474)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared GHR pathway dysfunction in these conditions could lead to targeted therapies aimed at restoring or mimicking GHR signaling for growth promotion and metabolic improvement.
